response.sql: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(1.0 * l.ALP / NULLIF(l.GPT, 0)) AS avg_alp_gpt FROM Patient AS p JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory AS x WHERE x.ID = p.ID AND x.`U-PRO` = '-') GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX) SELECT SEX, AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_pt, AVG(avg_alp_gpt) AS avg_alp_gpt FROM patient_averages GROUP BY SEX

assumptions.assumption: A patient must have at least one laboratory record to appear in the result.

alternatives.interpretation: Patients with no laboratory records also qualify; their per-patient averages are NULL.
alternatives.sql: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(1.0 * l.ALP / NULLIF(l.GPT, 0)) AS avg_alp_gpt FROM Patient AS p LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory AS x WHERE x.ID = p.ID AND x.`U-PRO` = '-') GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX) SELECT SEX, AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_pt, AVG(avg_alp_gpt) AS avg_alp_gpt FROM patient_averages GROUP BY SEX
